package.name: rost_state
package.description:
Reusable ROS2 FSM (Finite State Machine) framework for robot task management.
Provides: - BaseFSM: abstract base class for all FSMs - TopFSM: supervisor FSM managing global robot state and battery policy - Sub FSMs: DeliveryFSM, PickupFSM, FollowFSM, GuideFSM - FsmNode: ROS2 node hosting TopFSM with topic I/O
Future feature packages (delivery, pickup, follow, guide, …) can import BaseFSM and the shared event/state enums to implement their own Sub FSMs without modifying this package.
